layout.title: Thai Massage & Spa
layout.description: Hannah Thai Spa brings genuine wellness treatments to Castle Bromwich. A calm, welcoming space inside one of Birmingham's most beautiful historic buildings.

hero.title: Thai Massage & Spa Treatments in Castle Bromwich
hero.text: Rooted in traditional Thai practice, our treatments are designed to ease tension, restore balance, and leave you feeling like yourself again. A calm, welcoming space — right here in Birmingham.

services.title: Thai Massage, Body Rituals & Spa Packages in Birmingham
services.description: Not sure where to start? These are some of our most loved treatments — from a firm traditional massage to a full three-hour wellness journey. All rooted in Thai tradition, all delivered with care.

service1.name: Thai Traditional Massage
service1.description: A firm, revitalising massage that combines hot oil, deep sustained pressure, and traditional Thai stretching techniques. Ideal for releasing chronic tension and restoring mobility throughout the body.

service2.name: Couples Massage Package
service2.description: Enjoy a full hour of side-by-side massage in a calm, shared space — a lovely way to slow down and reconnect together.

service3.name: The Lotus Wellness Journey
service3.description: A three-hour journey through our finest treatments, designed for those who want to truly step away and switch off.

whyUs.title: Thai-Run, Traditionally Trained, Beautifully Located
whyUs.imageAlt: Hannah Thai Spa treatment room inside Castle Bromwich Hall
whyUs.description: At Hannah Thai Spa, authenticity isn't a selling point — it's simply how we work. Our Thai therapists bring years of training and genuine tradition to every session, in one of Birmingham's most beautiful settings.

reason1.description: Our therapists are Thai — not just trained in Thai techniques, but rooted in them. That difference shows in every treatment we deliver.

reason2.description: We're based inside Castle Bromwich Hall, a stunning historic building now home to a boutique hotel. It sets the tone from the moment you arrive.

reason3.description: Whether you're booking for two or treating yourself to a full spa journey, our packages are designed to give you the most from your visit.

whyUs.testimonial: There's nothing quite like the feeling of leaving a treatment knowing it was done properly — that's what we're here for.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.imageAlt: Reception and waiting area at Hannah Thai Spa, Castle Bromwich Hall
faq.question1: Do I need to book in advance?
faq.answer1: Online booking is preferred and can be done easily through our website. Walk-ins are always welcome, though we'd recommend booking ahead to avoid disappointment — especially at weekends.
faq.answer2: Yes — free parking is available in the Castle Bromwich Hall hotel car park, so you can arrive and leave without any hassle.
faq.question3: What facilities are available at the spa?
faq.answer3: We have a shower room and changing facilities on site, so you're welcome to freshen up before or after your treatment.
faq.answer4: Yes, we accept credit and debit card payments. Payment can be made on the day of your visit.
faq.question5: Is there a discount for hotel guests?
faq.answer5: Guests staying at Castle Bromwich Hall receive £10 off all treatments — just mention it when booking or at reception on arrival.
